item.title: Ohio State Kicker Jackson Courville Enters Transfer Portal After One Year As Buckeye
item.description: Neither kicker from Ohio State’s 2025 roster will be back in 2026. Jackson Courville, who backed up Jayden Fielding this season, announced Friday that he is entering the transfer portal after one year with the Buckeyes.
